environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless function deployed on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway HTTP API (v2) with default passthrough integration. No request body size limits configured beyond Lambda's 6MB default. Function URL is publicly accessible via the API Gateway endpoint. No authentication configured on the route. Runtime: GraalVM CE 22.3 native-image with --allow-incomplete-classpath and -H:+AllowUnsafeAccess flags.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API v2, passthrough, no auth
config.tls: standard TLS termination at API Gateway
